creator: Alexander Terp
description: An agent can tell the human something two ways: by posting to @human, or by leaving it as text in its own pane. They reach the person differently, and agents mix them up. Settled in the Lectern page muster-group-conversation (2026-10-24): which one an agent should use is for the user's skills to say, since Muster imposes no workflow, but muster docs msg should state the mechanics plainly so a skill author can write that rule. A post to @human raises a banner and waits in the group's conversation; text left in a pane is seen only when somebody opens that pane. A reply from the human reaches the agent inside its own session, so the agent's session holds both.
title: msg docs say how a post and a pane's own text each reach the human
